_comment: Homelab Bridge with the two monitor sources (docs/REFERENCE_SERVER.md#sources). Against the fake upstreams: python3 server/fake_upstream.py server/recordings/uptime-kuma/normal.json --port 8796 and python3 server/fake_upstream.py server/recordings/gatus/normal.json --port 8797, then HOMELAB_TOKENS=<16+ characters> python3 server/reference_server.py --config server/examples/sources-monitors.json. For a real Uptime Kuma, set url to its address and slug to a status page's slug; for a real Gatus, its address.
